tools.name: fixture_capture
tools.description: Capture one reproducible scenario with bounded, parameterized, read-only reads. Input is fixture_plan inputs or its returned plan. Captures every Kafka partition window, correlation matches, offsets and provenance. Masks sensitive values consistently by default. Returns capture id + interactive explorer; gaps/truncation prevent a claim of completeness. Never writes to the environment.

tools.name: scenario_state_plan
tools.description: Bind every passport read independently before emulation. Bindings by dependency id: {mode:"provided",value} for explicit fixtures, {capture:"fixture capture id",table:"db:schema.table"|topic:"name"}, or {mode:"capture",query:{...}}. No invented empty state. Ambiguous targets require resolve:{db,...,evidence}; unknown dependencies remain incomplete until modeled.

tools.name: scenario_state_capture
tools.description: Materialize the independently inspectable state plan. Provided fixtures and PG/Kafka captures are local; explicit capture readers support parameterized PG, bounded Kafka/ES, and allowlisted GET/HEAD HTTP. Missing, failed or truncated dependencies keep complete=false. Mask personal/secret fields by default. Returns saved state id and a view.

tools.name: fixture_validate
tools.description: Inspect one saved fixture capture separately: recheck captured parent relationships and return all capture gaps, completeness and counts. Does not query the environment or write scratch databases; fixture_replay separately validates real SQL and constraints.

tools.name: scenario_package
tools.description: Package a complete passport scenario: captured reads, bound action inputs, independent expectations, optional PG/Kafka fixture files, and a reviewed runtime profile. Writes portable versioned test resources and returns their path/hash. Full data stays in the default visualization; include_artifact=true returns it for transfer. No application execution.

tools.name: scenario_start
tools.description: Start the unchanged Node service in a private Docker network-none container, arrange exact HTTP fixtures/config/files, wait for readiness and return a leased session. No host ports, sockets, environment credentials or live HTTP fallback. Poll with job if still running. Use scenario_stop when finished.

tools.name: fixture_plan
tools.description: Offline plan for related test data across Postgres databases and Kafka. Reads cached schemas, FKs and usage indexes first. Seeds use explicit db/schema.table and equality filters. Follows schema FKs; cross-database joins are explicit relations. Returns candidates for review, never guesses them as facts. Inspect then pass the inputs to fixture_capture.

tools.name: fixture_schema
tools.description: Inspect Kafka correlation paths independently from capture. Reads cached JSON Schema, Avro, flattened fields and samples, with evidence and types. An optional path is checked against the known shape; unknown schemas do not establish a missing path. Headers may have undeclared keys.

tools.name: scenario_emulate
tools.description: Emulate the complete bound passport contract using only captured local state. Sandboxed JS sees vars.actions and ONLY await tools.action_input({id}), tools.state_read({id,action?,where?,key?,request?}), tools.observe({id,value}). Every selected action, required dependency read and expected effect is checked; no live dt tools are exposed. This verifies an explicit local model; run real service tests with test_run for application proof.

tools.name: scenario_run
tools.description: Run a verified scenario end to end. The node-container adapter arranges isolated reads, starts the actual service, invokes actions, independently observes effects and always stops. The test-run adapter runs reviewed real project tests with verified multi-DB fixtures and checks the independent observation report. Poll with job if still running; proof levels and unsupported boundaries remain explicit.

tools.name: scenario_state_get
tools.description: Inspect one captured read dependency separately, without running an action. Optional where filters row/document arrays, key selects a captured cache entry, request selects exactly one explicitly provided HTTP exchange. Never calls live systems.

tools.name: experiment_run
tools.description: Run a saved read-only experiment. Retains assertions, returned value, calls and timings for comparison; optionally exposes a masked fixture capture as vars.fixture.
